broken_cover_config.description: Cover {cover} could not be loaded: {error}. Fix its configuration; the cover is skipped until then.
broken_cover_config.title: Cover configuration is invalid

broken_profile_config.description: Schedule profile {profile} could not be loaded: {error}. Fix its configuration; the profile is skipped until then.
broken_profile_config.title: Schedule profile configuration is invalid

command_failures.description: Three consecutive commands to {cover} failed or were never confirmed. Check the cover and its integration.
command_failures.title: Cover commands keep failing

cover_unsupported.description: {cover} does not support the position features Cover Automation needs and cannot be automated.
cover_unsupported.title: Cover does not support required features

door_sensor_unavailable.description: {cover}'s door sensor is unavailable, so door protection cannot be evaluated for this cover.
door_sensor_unavailable.title: Door sensor is unavailable

forecast_fetch_failed.description: Cover Automation could not fetch the daily forecast from the weather entity. Hot-day evaluation is paused until it succeeds again.
forecast_fetch_failed.title: Daily forecast could not be fetched

frost_conflict.description: {cover} should open for wind or door protection, but the outdoor temperature is at or below the frost threshold so it was left in place.
frost_conflict.title: Wind or door protection blocked by frost

frost_source_unavailable.description: The outdoor temperature source used for frost protection is unavailable, so frost protection cannot be evaluated.
frost_source_unavailable.title: Frost temperature source is unavailable

missing_entity.description: The entity {entity_id} referenced by Cover Automation does not exist. Fix the configuration or restore the entity.
missing_entity.title: Configured entity is missing

missing_profile.description: Cover {cover} references a schedule profile that was deleted. It behaves as if it had no profile until you pick another one.
missing_profile.title: Schedule profile is missing

quiet_conflict.description: On {cover}, another of its schedule profiles is in quiet hours when {rules} would fire, so {rules} never acts. Move the rule outside those quiet hours, or take one of the profiles off this cover.
quiet_conflict.title: A schedule rule is blocked by another profile's quiet hours

room_sensor_unusable.description: {cover}'s room temperature sensor is unavailable or reporting an invalid value, so shading cannot use it.
room_sensor_unusable.title: Room temperature sensor is unusable

rule_skipped.description: Rule {rule} in schedule profile {profile} could not run and was skipped.
rule_skipped.title: Schedule rule was skipped

sun_missing.description: sun.sun is unavailable, so Cover Automation cannot evaluate sun position for shading.
sun_missing.title: Sun entity is missing

weather_unavailable.description: The weather entity configured for Cover Automation is unavailable, so sun and hot-day evaluation cannot run.
weather_unavailable.title: Weather entity is unavailable

wind_sensor_unavailable.description: The wind sensor configured for Cover Automation is unavailable, so wind protection cannot be evaluated.
wind_sensor_unavailable.title: Wind sensor is unavailable

wind_unit_changed.description: {cover}'s wind sensor used to report in {stored} but now reports in {current}. Check the sensor and the wind thresholds.
wind_unit_changed.title: Wind sensor unit changed

evaluate_now.description: Re-evaluates the targeted covers immediately and moves any whose desired state differs from where they are. Without a target every cover is evaluated.
evaluate_now.name: Evaluate now

reset_override.description: Clears the manual override on the targeted covers, handing them back to the automation. Without a target every cover's override is cleared.
reset_override.name: Reset override
